name: Solar-system ephemerides and orientation (NAIF)
description: Retrieval nodes for the planetary, satellite and small-body ephemerides and the lunar orientation that propagator/solar-system-bodies reads: DE440s, the JPL satellite kernels (mar099s, jup365, sat441, ura184, nep097, plu060), SSD sb441-n16 (Ceres, Vesta), the DE440 lunar PA binary PCK and the pck00011, gm_de440 and lunar frame text kernels from NASA/JPL NAIF and SSD. Nothing is downloaded whole: plan_kernels and four advance stages ask for the DAF file records, summary and name records, type-2 segment directories and one Chebyshev record window per needed segment by HTTP range; build_kernels copies each decade's records unchanged into new DAF shards (CSPICE spksub/pckw02 semantics, no refit) named as the module reads them (core-1950.bsp ... moon-pa-2040.bpc, the satellite systems from 2000); announce_kernels turns the IPFS add results into one $PNM per file. Fetching, IPFS and storage belong to the host; the node's auto-publisher announces the PNM.fbs lane provider naif, source ssb-kernels.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic range planning over DAF headers and one copy of selected Chebyshev records into new DAF files. No host calls, threads or network access.
